knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The rule is to stop, report and move to the assembly point, without using the lift.
Phones are limited to the rest room and emergencies, and are not used while operating equipment.
The client's premises are inspected before workers are placed, so welfare arrangements are confirmed.

practicalCriteria: Stops work on a simulated alarm, reports it and moves to the named assembly point without using the lift
Keeps a phone out of a work area and uses it only where the rule permits
Records a welfare check for a simulated new site, with each facility noted
Washes hands and face before a simulated break, and covers a simulated cut
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: Work continues during a simulated alarm
A person re-enters the building before the building facilities team confirms it is safe
A phone is used while operating equipment
